title: Under the Willow
inspect_text: The willow takes up most of the yard. Its long branches hang to the ground and sweep the sidewalk when the wind comes, and its roots have pushed one square of pavement up like a lid. A low fence runs along the street. From here you can see the porch steps and the green door.

features.label: willow
features.inspect_text: The trunk is wider than you can reach around. Under the curtain of branches there is a dry circle of dirt where children wait for rides. Someone has left a single mitten on a root.

features.label: tilted sidewalk
features.inspect_text: One square of sidewalk tilts up at a corner. Every child who comes here steps on it once, on purpose.

features.label: fence
features.inspect_text: A low iron fence, painted the same green as the door. The latch is set high enough that small hands can't reach it.

features.label: mitten
features.inspect_text: A red mitten, damp, with a thumb that has been chewed. It has been here since Monday. There is a bin in the basement for these.

title: Front Porch
summary: Deep and shaded, with a swing and a green door.
inspect_text: The porch is deep and shaded, with a swing at one end and a green door with white trim. Your bicycle is chained to the rail. Through the glass in the door you can see a lamp on in the waiting room.

features.label: swing
features.inspect_text: A wooden swing on two chains. A card taped to one chain reads, in the director's handwriting, "Staff may not remove the swing."

features.label: front door
features.inspect_text: Deep sage green with white trim, a shade darker than the walls inside. The brass knob is worn bright in the middle, and a second, lower handle has been added at a child's height.

features.label: bicycle
features.inspect_text: Your bicycle, chained to the rail. The canvas bag clips off the back. Inside are five picture books, a pencil stub, tissues, a folded cloth, and a small wind-up timer.

features.label: doormat
features.inspect_text: The mat says WELCOME in letters worn down to WELC.

title: Waiting Room
summary: Low chairs, a fish tank, and a reception desk.
inspect_text: A small room with low chairs along two walls and a rug in a faded pattern of leaves. A fish tank bubbles on a stand. Gloria's reception desk sits to one side, and a doorway at the back leads to the hall. It smells of warm radiator and, faintly, toast.

features.label: reception desk
features.inspect_text: The sign-in sheet hangs on a clipboard from a string. Beside it sit a jar of stickers, sorted by color, and a mug that says WORLD'S OKAYEST BEEKEEPER.

features.label: pickup cards
features.inspect_text: A corkboard of index cards, one for each child, each with a photo of whoever is coming to collect them and a time. Today's cards have been checked off in green pen.

features.label: fish tank
features.inspect_text: Four small fish and a snail. The snail is on the glass at a child's eye level, as always.

features.label: chairs
features.inspect_text: Child-size chairs along the walls, and three adult-size ones that look as if they were added later.

features.label: fidget basket
features.inspect_text: A basket of things to turn over in your hands, such as smooth stones, a cube with buttons on every side, and a loop of bright string.

features.label: picture books
features.inspect_text: A low shelf of picture books with the covers facing out. Several have been mended with tape.

title: Ground-Floor Hall
summary: A narrow hall, doors on both sides, and stairs up and down.
inspect_text: A narrow hall with a worn runner and doors on both sides. A staircase goes up on the left, and a smaller one goes down at the back. The walls are covered in children's drawings, none of them with a name on the front.

features.label: drawings
features.inspect_text: Crayon houses, a purple dog, a map of nowhere, a very serious portrait of a cat. There are no names, only dates in small pencil on the back.

features.label: coat hooks
features.inspect_text: A row of hooks at two heights. The low ones hold small coats and one stuffed dinosaur that has been waiting since Tuesday.

features.label: white noise machine
features.inspect_text: A small gray machine on the floor by the playroom door hisses softly, like rain on leaves. It covers the voices inside.

descriptions.inspect_text: The small gray machine on the floor by the playroom door is turned low. It makes a thin, faint hush you notice only when you listen.
The small gray machine by the playroom door is off. The hall is quiet enough to hear the building: a pipe, a clock somewhere, a voice downstairs.

interactions.label: Turn the machine down
lines: You crouch and turn the knob until the hiss is thin and faint.

interactions.label: Turn the machine off
lines: You press the switch. The hiss stops, and the hall fills with the small sounds it was covering.

interactions.label: Turn the machine on
lines: You press the switch. The soft hiss comes back, like rain on leaves.

features.label: radiator
features.inspect_text: Cast iron, painted white. It knocks twice and then sighs.

features.label: bench
features.inspect_text: A bench with a cushion, for a parent who needs to sit for a moment before going in.

title: Playroom
summary: Sage walls, a beanbag by the window, two toy bins.
inspect_text: A former front parlor, twelve feet by fifteen, with a bay window and pine floors worn in two paths. The walls are soft sage and the blind is a paler green, so the afternoon light comes in gently. Everything is low, from the round table to the beanbag by the window to the shelf at a child's reach. It is very quiet.

features.label: beanbag
features.inspect_text: Deep and worn, the color of oatmeal. It has a dent in it about the size of a child.

features.label: toy bins
features.inspect_text: Two identical lidded bins stand at either end of the shelf. Lift a lid and you find blocks, animals, hand puppets, a wooden train, and a family of plain wooden dolls, in no particular order.

features.label: toy shelf
features.inspect_text: Open and low, with the toys sorted loosely. There is a toy kitchen with three cups, a doctor's kit, a box of costumes, and a sand tray with a lid.

features.label: picture books
features.inspect_text: Your books, mostly, with the covers facing out. You have read each of them at least twice, and some of them a great many more times.

features.label: road rug
features.inspect_text: A printed road runs across the rug with a little town along it. There is a bakery, a school, two houses, and a bridge. Some of the squares are more worn than others.

features.label: timer
features.inspect_text: A small wind-up timer in the shape of a pear. It is quiet until it chimes.

features.label: rules card
features.inspect_text: A card by the door in your handwriting, with a small bird drawn beside each line. Nothing gets hurt. You can say it or not say it. When the timer chimes, we're done.

features.label: crayon basket
features.inspect_text: A basket of crayons, mostly worn. One red crayon has been used down to a stub, and every child who comes ends up picking it.

features.label: your chair
features.inspect_text: Soft and lower than most. When you sit in it, your eyes are at the height of a six-year-old's.

features.label: reading lamp
features.inspect_text: A lamp with a warm bulb, by the beanbag. A dial on the cord turns it up and down.

descriptions.inspect_text: The lamp is turned low. The bulb glows amber and the shade throws a small circle on the floor by the beanbag.
The lamp is on, a steady warm yellow. It lights the beanbag and the corner around it.
The lamp is off. Its shade is the color of weak tea.

interactions.label: Turn the lamp on
lines: You switch the lamp on. A warm yellow fills the corner by the beanbag.

interactions.label: Turn the lamp down
lines: You turn the dial down until the bulb glows low and amber.

interactions.label: Turn the lamp up
lines: You turn the dial up. The glow grows to a steady yellow.

interactions.label: Turn the lamp off
lines: You switch the lamp off. The corner goes back to the room's own light.

features.label: blue cushion
features.inspect_text: A dusty blue cushion on the window seat, a little faded where the sun reaches it.

features.label: overhead light
features.inspect_text: A flat white panel in the ceiling, bright and even. The switch is by the door.

descriptions.inspect_text: The ceiling panel is dark. The room has only the light from the window and whatever else is on.

interactions.label: Turn the overhead light off
lines: You press the switch by the door. The ceiling goes dark, and the room settles into the window's light.

interactions.label: Turn the overhead light on
lines: You press the switch. The white panel comes on, even and bright.

features.label: window blind
features.inspect_text: A pale green roller blind on the bay window. The cord hangs by the frame. The window is open to the street.

descriptions.inspect_text: The blind is down. The light through it is green and even, and the street is only a sound.

interactions.label: Lower the blind
lines: You pull the cord and the blind slides down. The light turns soft and green.

interactions.label: Raise the blind
lines: You let the cord go slowly and the blind rolls up. The street comes back into the window.

features.label: round table
features.inspect_text: A round table, low enough for a child to sit at with their feet on the floor. A cloth hangs over the edge, almost to the rug. There is room underneath.

title: Bathroom
summary: Small and bright, with a step stool and a night light.
inspect_text: A small, bright bathroom with a low sink and a wooden step stool. A night light is plugged in by the door, even in the afternoon. The lock turns with a big, easy knob.

features.label: step stool
features.inspect_text: Painted wood, with a rubber foot at each corner. It has been used so much that the top step is smooth.

features.label: night light
features.inspect_text: A small round light shaped like a moon, glowing a pale yellow.

features.label: lock
features.inspect_text: A big round knob, easy for a small hand to turn. A card beneath it explains, for parents, that staff can open it from outside with a coin.

features.label: soap
features.inspect_text: Plain white soap with no smell at all. A hand towel hangs beside the sink at a child's height.

title: Kitchen
summary: A narrow kitchen with a kettle and the snack shelf.
inspect_text: A narrow kitchen at the back of the house, with a kettle on the stove and a window over the sink that looks onto the yard. A shelf by the fridge is the snack shelf. The room smells of toast.

features.label: snack shelf
features.inspect_text: Crackers in two kinds, a bowl of clementines for the winter, a tin of oat cookies, and a pitcher of water with a clean cloth over it.

features.label: kettle
features.inspect_text: A dented steel kettle. A box of tea sits beside it with a note that says, "For parents. Please take two."

features.label: fridge
features.inspect_text: Covered in a clinic's worth of paper. There is a schedule, a thank-you card in crayon, and a note in red pen that says WHO KEEPS TAKING THE GOOD SPOON.

features.label: window
features.inspect_text: The window looks onto the back yard, the painted hopscotch, and the back steps.

features.label: table
features.inspect_text: A small table with three mismatched chairs. One has a cushion tied on with a ribbon.

title: Back Yard
summary: A small fenced yard with a hopscotch and the back steps.
inspect_text: A small fenced yard with a hopscotch painted on the flagstones and two raised beds of herbs, cut back for the winter. Three gray steps lead up to the kitchen door. A side path with a ramp runs along the wall to the front of the house.

features.label: hopscotch
features.inspect_text: Painted in white on the flagstones. The number seven has been painted twice.

features.label: herb beds
features.inspect_text: Rosemary and thyme, still green. A small sign says, "Children water. Adults do not."

features.label: back steps
features.inspect_text: Three wooden steps painted gray, with a worn place in the middle of the top one. This is where the staff sit when they need a minute.

features.label: fence
features.inspect_text: A tall wooden fence, with a gate to the side path. The latch is out of a child's reach.

features.label: church bell
features.inspect_text: From here you can hear the bell of the church down the block. It rings the hour and, if you are listening for it, the half.

title: Second-Floor Landing
summary: A wide landing with a window and three doors.
inspect_text: A wide landing with a window onto the street and three doors. The stairs continue upward. From behind one closed door comes a low, muffled murmur.

features.label: window
features.inspect_text: From here you can see the corner, the bus stop, and the crossing guard in his orange vest.

features.label: door signs
features.inspect_text: Hand-lettered signs on the doors say SAND AND ART, QUIET ROOM, and FAMILY ROOM. The sign on the family room hangs from a hook, so it can be turned over to IN USE.

features.label: plant
features.inspect_text: A pothos that has outgrown its pot and is working its way along the window frame.

features.label: murmur
features.inspect_text: You can't make out words. It is the sound of a parent and a clinician talking slowly and carefully.

title: Sand and Art Room
summary: A tiled room with a sand tray and an easel.
inspect_text: A bright room with a long table, an easel, and a big sand tray under the window. The floor is tiled so it can be washed. Everything is a little messy, in a way that someone has planned.

features.label: sand tray
features.inspect_text: A wooden tray, with a shelf of tiny figures beside it. There are animals, trees, bridges, a house, and a boat. The sand is damp and smooth. A single white shell sits in one corner.

features.label: easel
features.inspect_text: A sturdy easel at a child's height, with a clean sheet clipped on. A cup of fat brushes stands on its ledge.

features.label: smocks
features.inspect_text: Old adult shirts hung backward on hooks, as smocks. Each has a tag with a name, and every tag has been scribbled over in crayon.

features.label: drying rack
features.inspect_text: Paintings drying on a rack. A purple storm, a green house, and a great deal of brown.

features.label: sink
features.inspect_text: A deep sink with a hose and a step. A sign says, "Wash the brushes, not the paintings."

title: Quiet Room
summary: A small, dim room with a mattress and weighted blankets.
inspect_text: A small, dim room with a mattress on the floor, a stack of weighted blankets, and a basket of stuffed animals. A sound machine murmurs like a far-off river. The lower half of the walls is covered in cork.

features.label: mattress
features.inspect_text: A firm mattress on the floor with a clean, soft sheet. A child could lie on it, or behind it, or under the blankets.

features.label: weighted blankets
features.inspect_text: Heavy and soft. The smallest one is covered in faded stars.

features.label: stuffed animals
features.inspect_text: A basket of stuffed animals in various states of wear. A lamb, an owl, a frog with one eye.

features.label: sound machine
features.inspect_text: A small speaker with a dial. The setting is stopped on river.

features.label: lamp
features.inspect_text: A lamp with a dimmer. Someone has taped a small arrow beside the switch, pointing down, and written "lower" beside it.

title: Family Room
summary: Two sofas, a low table, and tissues within reach.
inspect_text: A comfortable room with two sofas and a low table, and a window over the yard. A box of tissues is within reach of every seat. A bookshelf holds parenting books and a plant. It is where parents sit when there is something hard to say.

features.label: sofas
features.inspect_text: Two deep sofas set at an angle, so two people can sit without having to face each other. The cushions have been turned over many times.

features.label: tissues
features.inspect_text: A box on every flat surface. The one by the window is nearly empty.

features.label: window
features.inspect_text: The window looks down on the back yard and the herb beds.

features.label: bookshelf
features.inspect_text: Titles about sleep, school, and separation. A few have worn spines and Post-it notes sticking out.

features.label: toy basket
features.inspect_text: A small basket of toys in the corner for children who have to come along. Blocks, a plastic truck, a stuffed whale.

title: Third-Floor Landing
summary: A narrow landing under the roof, with a skylight.
inspect_text: A narrower landing under the roof, with a skylight and three doors. The air is warmer here and smells of paper and dust.

features.label: skylight
features.inspect_text: A square of gray sky. In summer the sun crosses the floor here in a bright stripe.

features.label: clipboard
features.inspect_text: A clipboard on a step stool, headed HOLIDAY SCHEDULE, with several names crossed out and written in again.

features.label: door labels
features.inspect_text: Three doors, labeled DIRECTOR, STAFF, and BOOKS. The last one has an extra sign that says, "Please close this softly. The books are sleeping."

title: Dr. Bell's Office
summary: A cluttered, welcoming office with a wall of framed drawings.
inspect_text: A cluttered, welcoming office with a desk buried under files, an armchair with a crocheted blanket, and a wall of children's art in cheap frames.

features.label: desk
features.inspect_text: Files in stacks, a lamp with a green shade, and a mug of pens. A sticky note on the monitor says, "Ask Teo about the whale."

features.label: framed art
features.inspect_text: Forty drawings in cheap frames, from children who are now grown. Each has a small gold sticker in the corner with a year.

features.label: clay figures
features.inspect_text: A shelf of small clay figures, each made by a child in the sand and art room. Dr. Bell fired them in a kiln she bought secondhand.

features.label: armchair
features.inspect_text: A deep armchair with a crocheted blanket over the arm. It is turned to face the window and not the desk.

title: Staff Room
summary: A long table, mismatched mugs, and a crowded whiteboard.
inspect_text: A long table with mismatched mugs, a fridge that hums, and a whiteboard covered in names and room numbers in four colors. Coats hang on every hook.

features.label: whiteboard
features.inspect_text: The week, in four colors. Today, in green, it says Isla, 4:00, Playroom, and just the first letter of a name. Beside it, in blue, Teo, 4:00, Sand Room. In red, underlined, PICKUP CARDS.

features.label: mugs
features.inspect_text: No two alike. Yours is the one with the chipped handle and a picture of a very old cat.

features.label: fridge
features.inspect_text: Lunches in paper bags with names, and a container of soup labeled DO NOT EAT, MARGUERITE.

features.label: coat hooks
features.inspect_text: A row of coats. A long green one, a yellow rain jacket, a tweed jacket with one elbow patched, and a small gray hat.

title: Book Room
summary: An attic room lined with shelves of picture books.
inspect_text: A long, narrow attic room lined floor to ceiling with shelves. Picture books fill most of them, sorted loosely by subject. Moving, new babies, big feelings, bedtime, school. A rolling ladder leans against the wall.

features.label: shelves
features.inspect_text: The spines are labeled in marker. MOVING, NEW BABY, BIG FEELINGS, BEDTIME, SCHOOL, DEATH, DIVORCE.

features.label: ladder
features.inspect_text: A wooden ladder on a rail. It squeaks, and the squeak has been described, by three staff members, as comforting.

features.label: donation box
features.inspect_text: A box of donated books waiting to be sorted. On top is a note that says, "Please do not give me another dinosaur one."

features.label: art supplies
features.inspect_text: Reams of paper, jars of pencils, and a crate of crayon stubs the clinic won't throw away.

title: Basement
summary: A low basement with a washer, a furnace, and shelves of blankets.
inspect_text: A low basement with a washer and dryer, a furnace that clicks on and off, and shelves of folded blankets and beanbag covers. The stairs creak behind you. It is warm and smells like clean laundry.

features.label: washer
features.inspect_text: The washer is running. A beanbag cover tumbles inside it, slowly.

features.label: blanket shelves
features.inspect_text: Folded blankets and beanbag covers in tidy stacks, sorted by color. There are a great many more than seem necessary.

features.label: furnace
features.inspect_text: Old, with several patches. It clicks on with a sound that carries all the way up to the playroom.

features.label: mitten bin
features.inspect_text: A bin labeled LOST MITTENS, full to the brim, none of them in pairs.
